web.name: Websites
web.tagline: A one-page website for a tradesperson, freelancer or a new service.
features: One page with 4–6 sections: intro, services, about, references, contact
Design in your logo colours, comfortable on phone and desktop
A contact form that lands straight in your inbox
Tap-to-call phone number, map and social links
SEO basics: titles, descriptions and a link preview for sharing
Launch on your domain, including HTTPS
One round of revisions after handover
web.extra: You supply the copy and photos. Domain and hosting are paid separately — we'll help you choose.

seo.name: SEO
seo.tagline: A one-off check and fix of the basics on a website you already have.
features: Site check: what Google sees, speed and mobile errors
Google Search Console and Google Analytics connected
New titles and descriptions for up to 10 pages
Headings and image alt texts fixed on the main pages
Sitemap (sitemap.xml) and robots.txt set up
Your business profile on Google Maps checked
A report: what we fixed and what's worth doing next
seo.extra: Ongoing monthly SEO, article writing and link building are quoted separately.

Card payments via a gateway (Comgate, GoPay or Stripe), bank transfer and cash on delivery
Shipping: Packeta, PPL or Czech Post, with the price calculated in the cart
Automatic order emails and invoices
Terms and conditions, returns policy and GDPR added to the shop
A one-hour walkthrough: adding a product and handling an order
eshop.extra: The platform's monthly fee and payment fees go directly to their providers. You supply the legal texts.

One round of revisions and 30 days of bug fixes after launch

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: This document describes how we handle the data you send us through the form on this site.
privacy.metaDescription: How ELEVATE handles personal data from the enquiry form: what we collect, why, how long we keep it, and your rights.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.body: The controller of personal data is {company}, registered at {city}, {postal}, Czech Republic. Contact email: {email}.

sections.title: 2. What data we process
sections.body: We process the data you enter in the enquiry form yourself: your name, e-mail and, optionally, phone, WhatsApp or Telegram, information about the project (type, industry, starting point, budget, timing, links to websites you like) and your message. We also process the sender's IP address, solely to protect the form against abuse.

sections.title: 3. Why we process it
sections.body: We use the data only to reply to your enquiry and prepare a quote. The legal basis is pre-contractual negotiation at your request and our legitimate interest in protecting the form from spam.

sections.title: 4. How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep enquiries for as long as needed to handle them and then for a maximum of 24 months, unless agreed otherwise.

sections.title: 5. Who we share it with
sections.body: Enquiries are stored in a Supabase database (Supabase, Inc.) that only the site administrator can access. E-mails are delivered by Resend (Resend, Inc.). The form is protected against bots by Cloudflare Turnstile (Cloudflare, Inc.), which checks technical browser data on submission — with no advertising cookies. The website is hosted on Vercel. If analytics is enabled, we use the cookieless tool Plausible. We do not sell any data or share it with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.title: 6. Cookies
sections.body: By default the site uses no marketing or analytics cookies. If we later enable analytics that requires consent, we will show you a consent bar before anything is stored.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access your data, to have it corrected or erased, to restrict processing, to data portability and to object. Just write to our contact email. You also have the right to complain to the Czech Data Protection Authority (uoou.gov.cz).
